scripts.build: npm run build -w @voice-support/contracts && npm run build -w @voice-support/widget && npm run build -w demo
scripts.dev:api: bash -lc '[ -x .venv/bin/python ] || python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r services/api/requirements.txt >/dev/null; .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --app-dir services/api'
scripts.dev:all: bash -lc 'npm run dev:api & npm run dev:demo; wait'
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w demo && npm run lint -w @voice-support/widget
scripts.test: npm run test -w @voice-support/contracts && npm run test -w @voice-support/widget
